samples.question: The source mosaic and three ledgers are cut into one uninterrupted navy atlas; if the atlas is torn or has a background-colored hole, answer unreadable. In the gold-framed source, cyan cells sharing a side form one island; corner contact does not join islands. For each island, count every cell side touching cream or the outside of the source. Sort the four counts smallest to largest. Candidate ledgers show the counts as bottom-up lavender stacks read left to right. Which tag marks the exact ledger? Answer red, green, or blue.
